assumptions.premise: Spending more time at a company should place you ahead of newer colleagues for advancement.
assumptions.probe: What expectation comes up for you when the person chosen has "been there less time" than you?

assumptions.premise: Exerting more effort than your peers is what should determine who gets promoted.
assumptions.probe: What link do you see between who can "work harder than anyone" and who receives a promotion?

assumptions.premise: Missing out on a promotion is a verdict on your personal adequacy.
assumptions.probe: What leads you from being passed over to wondering if you are "not good enough"?
